Course · Chinese for English speakers

Learn Mandarin Chinese with the grammar explained.

A complete Mandarin Chinese course for English speakers, from pinyin and the four tones to the level of HSK 7–9: 80 modules in eight tiers, in simplified characters as written in mainland China. Pinyin is shown over every word until you no longer need it, measure words, complements, 了 and 把 are explained directly, and every exercise tells you why an answer is right or wrong.

Start learning free

The whole course is free. Specialization courses, HSK practice papers, conversation practice and the other extras are part of Premium, €8.99 a month or €69.99 a year.

The course, tier by tier

  1. Sounds, tones and first sentencesPinyin, the four tones and tone changes, how characters work and how to type them, 是.
  2. Everyday basicsNumbers and money, questions, measure words, time and dates, family.
  3. Daily lifeLocation, modal verbs, completed actions with 了, food and shopping.
  4. Building sentencesComplements of degree, result and direction, comparison, 把.
  5. Building fluencyPotential complements, the 被 passive, paired conjunctions, work.
  6. IntermediateCausatives, aspect in depth, written Chinese, 成语, cohesion.
  7. Upper intermediateFormal written Chinese, the news, politics, the economy, law, register.
  8. AdvancedClassical Chinese, academic writing, the varieties of Chinese and traditional characters.

80 modules. The tiers follow HSK 1 to HSK 7–9.

How it teaches

What the course teaches, and how

  • 1

    Sounds and tones first

    The first tier teaches the initials and finals of pinyin, the four tones and the way tones change next to each other, how characters are built from strokes and how to type them, before the first sentences with 是.

  • 2

    Pinyin you can take away

    In the early tiers pinyin is shown over every word, and you can hide it whenever you want to read the characters alone. Tap any word for its pinyin, its measure word and its traditional spelling.

  • 3

    The grammar taught directly

    Measure words, the aspect markers, 了 for completed actions and for change, the complements, the 把 and 被 constructions and the written register each have their own modules, explained in plain English with examples.

  • 4

    Feedback that says why

    Every answer gets feedback with a reason and a link to the grammar rule behind it. Every Chinese word can be tapped for its meaning, pinyin and audio.

  • 5

    Pronunciation feedback

    Speaking exercises assess your pronunciation of Chinese sentences word by word.

  • 6

    A placement test

    If you already know some Chinese, the placement test shows where to start, so you do not have to work through what you know.

Exam preparation

Practice papers for the HSK

The course has timed practice papers for the new HSK (汉语水平考试), whose levels 1 to 6 Chinese Testing International launches worldwide on 13 December 2026, with two papers at each level. Each level's papers are written for learners who have finished the matching tier. What the papers cover and how they differ from the real test.

  • HSK 1, after Tier 2
  • HSK 2, after Tier 3
  • HSK 3, after Tier 4
  • HSK 4, after Tier 5
  • HSK 5, after Tier 6
  • HSK 6, after Tier 7
  • HSK 7–9, the advanced exam, after Tier 8

Questions

Common questions

Do I need to know pinyin or any characters before I start?
No. The first tier starts with pinyin and the four tones, then how characters are written and how to type them on a phone or computer, before the first sentences.
Simplified or traditional characters?
The course teaches Mandarin as written in mainland China, in simplified characters. Tapping a word shows its traditional spelling too, and the last tier has a module on the varieties of Chinese and traditional characters.
Does the course prepare me for the HSK?
The tiers follow HSK 1 to HSK 7–9, and Premium has two timed practice papers at each level of the new HSK. The papers show the share of points you got, not an HSK score, and no course can promise a pass.
Is the Chinese course really free?
Yes. All 80 modules, the grammar reference, word practice, the placement test and 5 Ask AI questions a day are free. The HSK papers, specializations, stories, conversation practice and the other extras are part of Premium.
Can I practise speaking and tones?
The course's speaking exercises give feedback on your pronunciation word by word. With Premium you can also hold typed or spoken conversations with an AI character in 36 everyday and work situations, and practise pronunciation on sentences you type.
